name: International Journal of Structural Stability and Dynamics

publisher.name: World Scientific Publishing Co Pte Ltd

scope.summary: Structural stability and dynamics, including structural engineering, vibration, conventional and emerging structures, and engineering applications.
fit_notes: Suitable trial venue for AI-assisted structural dynamics, structural health monitoring, vibration analysis, digital twins and physics-informed machine learning.
Not a default target for papers whose primary contribution is generic AI, robotics control or manufacturing rather than structural dynamics.
Every paper requires a fresh scope-fit decision.

policy_notes: Verify article type, reference style, figures, declarations, AI-use policy, data policy, fees and submission files from the current official guidelines at G5.
Do not infer current requirements from the sample PDF alone.
